tasks.title: algo topo sort cycle
tasks.prompt: Write an Aether program that topologically sorts a 6-node DAG (nodes 0..5) whose directed edges are, as parallel from/to arrays, from=[5,5,2,3,3,1] to=[2,0,3,1,0,0]. Use in-degree counting, and when several nodes are simultaneously ready always take the LOWEST-numbered one so the output is deterministic. Print `order:` followed by each node preceded by a space, then on the next line `acyclic=<true|false> placed=<how many nodes were emitted>`.
tasks.achievability: verified: reference_solution compiles and produces expected_stdout byte-exact

tasks.title: algo lcs reconstruct

Report BOTH the length and the actual subsequence -- reconstruct it by walking the DP table back, not by guessing. When the two predecessor cells tie, prefer the one from the row above. Print `len=<n>` then `lcs=<subsequence>`.

tasks.title: algo record pipeline
tasks.prompt: Write an Aether program that runs a full pipeline over parallel arrays names=["ada","bob","cy","dee","eve"] and raw scores ["93","71","x8","60","88"]. Reject any score that is not entirely numeric (validate it -- a parse that returns 0 for junk cannot tell you). Build a record per surviving row with name, score and a band (A>=90, B>=75, C>=60, else D). Sort records by score DESCENDING. Then tally how many records fall in each band, in the order the bands first appear in the sorted list. Print `<i>: <name> <score> <band>` per record, then `band <B>=<count>` per band, then `kept=<n> rejected=<n> mean=<mean score to 2 decimals>`.

0: ada 93 A
1: eve 88 B
2: bob 71 C
3: dee 60 C
band A=1
band B=1
band C=2
kept=4 rejected=1 mean=78.00
